title: nas-docker-web-milestone

tests.execution_status: Consolidated native/Web, repository rules, final gate regression and actual NAS delivery passed; no skips.

risks: Manual browser trust/90-day certificate renewal; operator risk check requires a working outbound route.
NAS kernel provides memory caps and CPU shares, not CFS/PID hard limits.
Initial committed snapshots only; no preview, raw download, general rescan or asset writes.
Full Alpha, scale and other platform release gates remain blocked; V01-008 stays partial.

architecture_review.module: NAS Host/deployment, existing physical-path adapters and Web integration
reused_existing_logic: Existing trial Host/CLI, auth/session, read/query and durable scan modules.
Existing PostgreSQL migration/roles/backup and Web SDK/UI.
Existing worker failure propagation and physical-root validation.
cross_module_access: Only existing public ports; no cross-module table writes or Domain OS dependencies.
contract_changes: No wire, SQL, generated SDK or business permission changes. POSIX backslash paths fail explicitly at physical adapters.
Health probe keeps exact Host/SNI/certificate while routing locally. Runtime path and read group are deployment-only.
Risk network budget 2 to 4 seconds remains inside the existing overall 5-second deadline under ADR-0015.
M0-004-G2 alone closes on actual NAS evidence; complete Alpha remains blocked.
architecture_tests: Final repository/architecture/contract/source validation passed; 26 affected evidence-policy regressions passed.
63 Packaging + 25 Pwned + 2 Linux POSIX + 40 existing Web tests passed.
Actual NAS readonly browser/HTTPS/PostgreSQL/worker, restart, recovery, hardening and owned cleanup passed.
technical_debt: First-snapshot-only scope and existing full Alpha/asset-write/other-platform gaps remain explicit.
NAS CFS/PID limitations, manual certificate lifecycle and unreliable direct operator-risk egress remain documented.
